findings.evidence: “Sam Bankman-Fried sought a presidential pardon ... according to His public appeals...”
findings.detail: The capitalized “His” follows an incomplete “according to” construction, leaving the summary grammatically broken.

findings.evidence: It says the campaign “illustrated how Trump’s blanket alignment with the crypto industry transformed presidential clemency into a transactional commodity.”
